records.keyboard: Enter or Space activates on valid release semantics
records.disabled_behavior: Reject focus, capture, activation, and assistive actions.
records.validation: Require a bounded accessible name and canonical typed activation command.

records.keyboard: Enter or Space activates; tooltip never supplies the only name
records.disabled_behavior: Reject focus, capture, activation, and assistive actions.
records.validation: Require a bounded accessible name, registered icon, and canonical typed command.

records.keyboard: Space changes the typed value
records.disabled_behavior: Reject value changes, focus, capture, and assistive actions.
records.validation: Require a typed on, off, or mixed state and canonical value command.

records.keyboard: Grapheme navigation selection editing and validation commands
records.disabled_behavior: Reject focus, editing, IME, clipboard, completion, and assistive value changes.
records.validation: Bound retained text and apply the declared typed validation rule before commit.

records.keyboard: Escape clears or closes according to context
records.disabled_behavior: Reject focus, editing, IME, completion, and contextual clear actions.
records.validation: Bound the query and distinguish contextual clear from transient dismissal.

records.keyboard: Arrows navigate Enter accepts Escape cancels
records.disabled_behavior: Remain closed and reject focus, navigation, acceptance, and assistive actions.
records.validation: Require a bounded anchored option surface and stable option identities.

records.keyboard: Arrows Home End Enter and Escape follow native expectations
records.disabled_behavior: Remain closed or skip disabled items and reject their activation.
records.validation: Require bounded menu items, stable identities, and canonical item commands.

records.keyboard: Platform menu navigation and mnemonic policy
records.disabled_behavior: Skip disabled items and reject activation through every platform input path.
records.validation: Require bounded accessible labels and canonical commands behind the native adapter.

records.keyboard: Menu key opens at focus; Escape restores focus
records.disabled_behavior: Remain closed and reject context requests or disabled item activation.
records.validation: Require an explicit context binding, bounded surface, and deterministic focus restoration.

records.keyboard: Focus can reveal; Escape dismisses without moving focus
records.disabled_behavior: Stay hidden when its anchor is absent, disabled, or not visible.
records.validation: Require an existing anchor, bounded delay and text, and a nonessential description.

records.keyboard: Actions enter normal focus order only when invoked
records.disabled_behavior: Do not queue disabled notifications or expose disabled actions to focus.
records.validation: Bound queue size, text, duration, live-region behavior, and action commands.

records.keyboard: Arrows move tabs Home End jump and activation follows policy
records.disabled_behavior: Skip disabled tabs and reject activation, reorder, and drag operations.
records.validation: Require unique stable tab identities and one valid active tab per list.

records.keyboard: Arrows Home End Page and typeahead preserve stable identity
records.disabled_behavior: Skip disabled rows and reject expansion, selection, activation, and drops.
records.validation: Require stable row identity, bounded relationships, and valid semantic position metadata.

records.keyboard: Cell row and column traversal with Home End and Page behavior
records.disabled_behavior: Skip disabled cells and reject selection, activation, editing, and drops.
records.validation: Require stable cell identity and bounded row, column, sort, and selection metadata.

records.keyboard: Row traversal editing commit cancel reset and source inspection
records.disabled_behavior: Reject edit, reset, source inspection, clipboard, and drop mutations.
records.validation: Require an editor owned by the grid and a bounded typed value validation contract.

records.keyboard: Stable Home End Page and typeahead across unrealized rows
records.disabled_behavior: Reject navigation, selection, scrolling, and assistive actions.
records.validation: Bound source count and realized range while preserving stable row identities.

records.keyboard: Step jump range selection zoom and accessible value editing
records.disabled_behavior: Reject scrub, range, zoom, value, navigation, and drop operations.
records.validation: Require bounded minimum, maximum, step, page, value, range, and zoom contracts.

records.keyboard: Arrows resize by bounded logical increments; reset is exposed
records.disabled_behavior: Reject capture, resizing, reset, and assistive value changes.
records.validation: Require explicit bounded resize commands and accessible minimum panel extents.

records.keyboard: Related cancel retry and details are separate named actions
records.disabled_behavior: Keep progress read-only and expose unavailable related actions as separate disabled controls.
records.validation: Require coherent bounded progress, status, live-region, and related-action metadata.

records.keyboard: Type filters arrows select Enter invokes Escape restores focus
records.disabled_behavior: Keep unavailable results noninvokable and out of the active selection path.
records.validation: Bound query and results, require stable identities and canonical commands, and restore focus.

records.keyboard: Node and port traversal connect cancel zoom and inspect source
records.disabled_behavior: Reject unavailable graph mutations and cancel any preview without changing source.
records.validation: Require bounded pan and zoom plus stable typed node, port, connection, and source identities.

records.keyboard: Tool commands selection navigation and focus escape remain available
records.disabled_behavior: Expose unavailable state and reject tools or mutations while preserving focus escape.
records.validation: Require typed tool and selection commands, bounded navigation, and truthful capability state.
